SRType.description: Type of self refresh technology detected

isDefault.description: NV_SURROUND_DEFAULT - default 3 resolutions returned by display driver

isActiveResolution.description: NV_SURROUND_ACTIVE_RESOLUTION - resolution is visible to OS and user (and also to be shown in main surround resolution list)

SurroundResolution.description: Single surround resolution entry (width, height, flags)

applyWithBezelCorrect.description: When enabling and doing the modeset, do we switch to the bezel-corrected resolution

immersiveGaming.description: Enable as immersive gaming instead of Mosaic SLI (for Quadro-boards only)

isAutoconfiguredMultiTileDisplay.description: to check whether it is a tile display or not for quadro

useTopologyWithMaxGpus.description: this overwrites the existing policy of selecting GPU topology of Mosaic/SLI Mosaic

displays.description: Displays are done as [(row * columns) + column]

gpuIndex.description: Index of GPU for which information is required.
Index of GPU for which information is required.

ECCModeStatus.description: ECC Mode status of all the ECC Supported GPUs

IsECCModeSupported.description: returns whether ECC Mode setting is supported on the system.

GetECCModeStatus.description: returns the ECC Mode Status of all the GPUs which support ECC.

SetECCModeStatus.description: Sets the ECC Mode Status of all the GPUs which support ECC.

DisableVSROnGameLaunch.description: Indicates what to do with VSR when game is launched

DisableHDROnGameLaunch.description: Indicates what to do with HDR when game is launched

SetRTXHDRFlags.description: Sets what to do with HDR when game is launched

SetDisableVSROnGameLaunchStatus.description: Sets what to do with VSR when game is launched

SetDisableHDROnGameLaunchStatus.description: Sets what to do with HDR when game is launched

GetGpuCount.description: returns total number of GPU in system

LaunchApplication.description: Launches Legacy Nvidia Control Panel application

IsControlPanelClientInstalled.description: Returns Control Panel Client Installation state

min.description: Minimum value of Pulsar low FPS slider

max.description: Maximum value of Pulsar low FPS slider

current.description: Current value of Pulsar low FPS slider

canUsePulsar.description: Whether G-SYNC Pulsar can be used in the current runtime state

brightnessEnabled.description: Whether ambient adaptive brightness is enabled

colorEnabled.description: Whether ambient adaptive color is enabled

GetDisplaysState.description: returns topology and inactive displays information.

SetDisplaysState.description: configures the display Topology and returns the topology if the topology validation is successful

GetDebugModeStatus.description: returns the ECC Mode Status of all the GPUs which support ECC.

IsDebugModeSupported.description: returns whether Debug Mode feature is supported.

isSupported.description: Is Debug Mode Supported on this system or not.

GetDisplayResolutionList.description: returns the complete resolution list of a particular display.

GetGpuAndDisplayInformation.description: returns the complete GPU and display information.

GetIGpuAndDisplayInformation.description: returns the complete IGPU and display information.

GetGpuAndDisplaysPhysicalInformation.description: returns GPU's and its connected displasy physical properties.

showSpanIdentifiers.description:
Show span identifiers.
The identifiers are calculated from a different algorithm than the usual monitor identifiers.
When this is true we use nvcpl's surround dialog's logic,
otherwise we use the sumd page identify logic.
This will work irrespective of surround being enabled or disabled.

GetGsyncIndicator.description: returns G-SYNC indicator value saved in DRSDB

RestoreGlobalGsyncState.description: set and returns system's global gsyncState

SetDisplayPulsarInfo.description: Sets per-display G-SYNC Pulsar state (enabled and / or low FPS) for the given display.

GetDisplayAmbientAdaptiveInfo.description: returns per-display Ambient Adaptive Brightness and Color state for the given display.

isSupported.description: Whether Ambient Adaptive feature is supported

SetDisplayAmbientAdaptiveBrightnessInfo.description: Sets per-display Ambient Adaptive Brightness state for the given display.

brightnessEnabled.description: Whether ambient adaptive brightness is enabled

SetDisplayAmbientAdaptiveColorInfo.description: Sets per-display Ambient Adaptive Color state for the given display.

colorEnabled.description: Whether ambient adaptive color is enabled

AdvancedColorCombination.description: Represents a valid color combination for Advanced Color Settings.

GetAdvancedColorCombinationInfo.description: returns valid advanced color setting combinations

RestoreColorAccuracyMode.description: set and returns system's global gsyncState

GetColorAccuracyMode.description: returns per display color accuracy mode

CustomResolutionOperation.description: Custom resolution operation flags matching NVCPLAPI_ENUM_CT_OP

CustomResolutionLocalCacheActions.description: Possible actions for local Custom resolution cache

bIsAutomatic.description: system is in auto mode or not
system is in auto mode or not

bAcConnected.desceription: AC power is connected to the system, else running on DC

UIElemType.description: UI Element which we are referring to

isSupported.description: Whether the UI element is in a supported state

GetDDSBlockingApps.description: Returns a list of applications currently blocking Dynamic Display Switching

appList.description: Array of application names that are blocking DDS

items.description: Name of the application that is blocking DDS

isEnabled.description: Whether the hotkey is enabled or not

GetHotkeyStates.description: Returns the state of all hotkeys

globalHotKeysEnabled.description: Global hotkey state. Individual hotkeys will work only if this is enabled.

SetHotkeyStates.description: Sets the state of one or more hotkeys

hotkeyStates.description: Array of hotkey states to set.

globalHotKeysEnabled.description: Global hotkey state. Individual hotkeys will work only if this is enabled.

PerfCountRestrictionInfo.description: Returns admin status and perf counter access flag

GetSpanBezelOverlapLimits.description: Returns the surround bezel overlap limits. Call only if surround is enabled. When surround disabled don't enforce any limits

ShowBezelPreviewImage.description: Shows bezel preview image with the specified configuration

rows.description: Number of rows in the mosaic grid

columns.description: Number of columns in the mosaic grid

displays.description: Array of mosaic grid display configurations

displayIdPairs.description: Nested array where each sub-array contains a pair of display IDs. For 1xn, nx1 surround the array will only have a single pair. for 2x2 surround the array will have 2 pairs.

items.description: Pair of Display ID. The pair together represents a bezel edge. If this is not sent or is empty then hide existing bezel previews

GetCustomResolutions.description: Gets all custom resolutions for a display

PerformCustomResolutionOperation.description: Performs custom resolution operations (Set, Revert, Save) using flag-based pattern matching NvCplApiCTTest

DeleteCustomResolution.description: Deletes a custom resolution using NvCplApiCTDelete

GetSelectedCustomResolution.description: Gets all selected custom resolutions for a display

CalculateCustomTiming.description: Calculates custom timing parameters using NvCplApiCTCalc

SaveSelectedCustomResolution.description: Adds a resolution for a display device to the cache holding persisted unsupported resolutions using NVCPLAPI_HELPER_AddUnsupportedResolutionToCache

IsLegalDisclaimerAccepted.description: Checks if the custom resolution legal disclaimer has been accepted by reading the registry key 'CustomRezLegalAccepted'

isAccepted.description: True if the legal disclaimer has been accepted (registry value is 1), false otherwise

SetLegalDisclaimerAccepted.description: Sets the custom resolution legal disclaimer as accepted by writing the registry key 'CustomRezLegalAccepted' to 1

GetEnableHiddenResolutions.description: Gets the state of 'Enable resolutions not exposed by display' checkbox using NVCPLAPI_SETTING_MISC_HIDE_MODES. Returns true if hidden resolutions are enabled (checkbox checked), false otherwise

isEnabled.description: True if hidden resolutions are enabled (checkbox checked), false if disabled (checkbox unchecked)

SetEnableHiddenResolutions.description: Sets the state of 'Enable resolutions not exposed by display' checkbox using NVCPLAPI_SETTING_MISC_HIDE_MODES. Set true to enable hidden resolutions (check checkbox), false to disable (uncheck)

isEnabled.description: True to enable hidden resolutions (check checkbox), false to disable (uncheck)

GetContextMenuVisibility.description: Gets the visibility state of the NVIDIA App context menu by reading the registry key 'ContextUIPolicy'. Returns true if the context menu is visible (value is 1), false if hidden (value is 0)

isVisible.description: True if the context menu is visible (registry value is 1), false otherwise

SetContextMenuVisibility.description: Sets the visibility of the NVIDIA App context menu by writing the registry key 'ContextUIPolicy'. Pass true to show, false to hide

isVisible.description: True to show the context menu (sets registry value to 1), false to hide (sets registry value to 0)

IsGpuMemoryAllocationSupported.description: Returns whether GPU memory allocation is supported on this system.

GpuMemoryAllocationInfo.description: GPU memory allocation information. Allocation values are in MiB.

currentAllocation.description: Requested GPU memory allocation stored in firmware, in MiB. Equals activeAllocation when no restart is pending.

activeAllocation.description: GPU memory allocation in effect in firmware, in MiB.

minAllocation.description: Firmware-provided minimum GPU memory allocation in MiB.

maxAllocation.description: Maximum GPU memory allocation from the NDUP SKU fallback in MiB.

defaultAllocation.description: Default GPU memory allocation from the NDUP SKU fallback in MiB.

stepAllocation.description: Firmware-provided GPU memory allocation step size in MiB.

restoreAvailable.description: Whether the requested allocation differs from the packaged NDUP default for this system-memory SKU.

restorePending.description: Whether the packaged NDUP default is requested and will become active after restart.

totalSystemMemoryGB.description: Total physically installed system memory in GB.

intelligentCarveoutSupported.description: Whether Intelligent Carveout is supported on this system.

currentIntelligentCarveoutEnabled.description: Requested Intelligent Carveout state. Equals activeIntelligentCarveoutEnabled unless a pending write has been made.

GetGpuMemoryAllocationInfo.description: Returns GPU memory allocation information for supported N1X UMA systems.

SetGpuMemoryAllocation.description: Writes requested GPU memory allocation to firmware. Change takes effect after restart.

allocation.description: Requested GPU memory allocation in MiB.

RestoreGpuMemoryAllocation.description: Restores the GPU memory allocation to the packaged NDUP default for the system-memory SKU. Change takes effect after restart.

restartSystemNow.description: Whether to restart the system immediately after restoring the packaged NDUP default allocation.

SetIntelligentCarveout.description: Enables or disables Intelligent Carveout. Change may require driver restart or system restart to take effect.

GpuUtilizationPreferenceValue.description: Native GPU utilization YieldPct preference value.

GpuUtilizationPreferenceInfo.description: GPU utilization preference information returned by UXD.

currentYieldPct.description: Exact native YieldPct readback. Non-preset values are preserved.

supportedPreferences.description: Native preference values reported as supported by UXD.

IsGpuUtilizationPreferenceSupported.description: Returns whether GPU utilization preference is supported on this system.

GetGpuUtilizationPreferenceInfo.description: Returns the exact GPU utilization preference state reported by UXD.

SetGpuUtilizationPreference.description: Sets a GPU utilization YieldPct value.

yieldPct.description: GPU utilization YieldPct requested by NvApp.
